subject.title: fix(ai): honor Responses reasoning effort maps

question: Does the repository intend `model.provider === "openai"` plus `api === "azure-openai-responses"` to be the complete supported boundary for encrypted Responses reasoning replay?
rationale: This boundary controls continuation state across provider transports; the patch and tests cover OpenAI, Groq-compatible, and Azure cases, but deciding whether another supported route belongs in the replay set is an owner contract decision rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Confirm the current route boundary
options.body: Confirm that native OpenAI and Azure Responses are the only replay-capable routes, then rebase and merge after the final checks pass.

options.title: Generalize the capability contract
options.body: Replace provider/API identity checks with an explicit model or transport capability if another supported Responses route also requires encrypted replay.

recommendation.title: Confirm the current route boundary
recommendation.body: Confirm that native OpenAI and Azure Responses are the only replay-capable routes, then rebase and merge after the final checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline assigns steipete to this PR after the replay-boundary concern was surfaced.
